zusammenfassung: This week centres on major shifts: DeepSeek v3.2 resets the market for reasoning models with its open-source approach and very low prices. Taskade Genesis changes no-code by creating "living" applications from a single prompt, while TwelveLabs Marengo 3.0 sets new standards in enterprise video understanding.
highlights: Star of the week: DeepSeek v3.2 (10/10)
